annotations.title: State rules for buying a car

description: A state's car-buying rules: the dealer doc-fee cap or rule, sales tax (state rate, local add-on range, any cap), whether a trade-in lowers the taxed price, how a maker's rebate is taxed, and cancellation rights where on file. Each comes with its source, as-of date and confidence, plus the link to the state's page. Use it for the rules themselves; for a price with a city's local tax, use out_the_door.
